L2:

L7: Perfil
L8: 
L9: Si te apasionan los datos, quieres aprender en un entorno creativo y buscas dar tus primeros pasos en el mundo de la analítica aplicada al marketing y la automoción, este es tu sitio.
L10: En DDB Barcelona buscamos un/a Data Analyst Junior con ganas de aprender, crecer y desarrollarse en un entorno dinámico y creativo. Te incorporarás a una agencia de publicidad con un cliente líder del sector automoción, trabajando codo con codo con equipos de estrategia, marketing digital y tecnología, y participando en proyectos reales con impacto directo en negocio.
L11: Tu misión será dar soporte al análisis y la interpretación de datos digitales, ayudando a transformar la información en insights accionables que impulsen la toma de decisiones estratégicas del cliente.
L12: 
L13: Responsabilidades
L14:   * Análisis de datos de performance de la web, campañas digitales...etc.
L15:   * Elaboración de informes y dashboards de seguimiento de KPIs.
L16:   * Apoyo en la interpretación de resultados y detección de insights accionables.
L17:   * Colaboración con equipos de cuentas, estrategia y tecnología para responder a necesidades analíticas del cliente.
L18:   * Soporte en la automatización de reportes y procesos de análisis.
L19:   * Aprendizaje progresivo de herramientas avanzadas de analítica y BI.
L20: 
L21: Requisitos
L22:   * Conocimientos de Excel y Power Point
L23:   * Familiaridad con herramientas de analítica digital (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics).
L24:   * Capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y mentalidad orientada a negocio.
L25:   * Ganas de aprender, actitud proactiva y curiosidad por los datos.
L26:   * Interés por el sector automoción y el entorno digital.
L27: 
L28: Se valorará positivamente
L29:   * Formación en Business Intelligence y/o Marketing Digital.
L30:   * Experiencia académica o prácticas en análisis de datos, marketing digital o consultoría.
L31:   * Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar datos de forma clara y sencilla a cliente
L32: 
L33: Todas las candidaturas serán consideradas para el empleo, independientemente de su raza, orientación sexual o edad.

L7: Who we are
L8: 
L9: At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to【1† hundreds of thousands of businesses †customers.twilio.com】and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
L10: Our dedication to 【2†remote-first work†www.twilio.com】, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

L13: Hiring and how we work
L14: We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

L16: Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

L19: See yourself at Twilio
L20: 
L21: Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer.
L22: 
L23: About the job
L24: This position is to design and engineer AI powered features that makes every customer conversation smarter. As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Conversation Intelligence team, you'll develop and deploy solutions that extract meaning from voice and messaging data at Twilio scale. You'll work alongside experienced ML practitioners to ship real features - from model pipelines to production inference - that directly shape how businesses understand their customers.
L25: 
L26: Responsibilities
L27: 
L28: In this role, you’ll:
L29:   * Design and development of machine learning solutions, ensuring accuracy, performance, security, and scalability.
L30:   * Implement and maintain end-to-end AI/ML pipelines - from data ingestion and feature engineering through to model development, validation, and deployment with guidance from senior engineers on complex architectural decisions
L31:   * Instrument AI/ML services with appropriate metrics, logging, and telemetry to monitor model performance and operational health against defined SLOs
L32:   * Participate in on-call rotations, executing progressive rollouts and applying standard mitigation strategies to keep production inference services healthy
L33:   * Collaborate across planning, design, and code review phases contributing to product and technical discussions, while helping raise overall code quality through thoughtful review feedback
L34: Qualifications
L35: 
L36: Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
L37: 
L38: *Required:
L39:   * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
L40:   * 2+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or applied ML, with demonstrated proficiency in Python and at least one ML framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) and familiarity with NLP libraries such as Hugging Face Transformers, NLTK, or SpaCy.
L41:   * Experience developing, testing, and deploying small-to-medium scoped ML services or features in a collaborative engineering environment, including model versioning, experiment tracking, and cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
L42:   * Proficiency in Python (preferred) or similar OO language.
L43:   * Experience utilizing Large (or Small) Language Models within software systems.
L44:   * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
L45: Desired:
L46: 
L47:   * Hands-on experience with conversational AI, or LLM fine-tuning and prompt engineering in a production  context
L48:   * Exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI
L49:   * Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling related to maintaining models in production such as testing, versioning, model registry, retraining, and monitoring.
L50:

L52: 
L53:   1. This role will be remote from Ireland.

L56: We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
L57: 
L58: What We Offer
L59: 
L60: Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
L61:

L63: We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call 【3†Twilio Magic†www.twilio.com】. Additionally, we empower employees to build 【4†positive change in their communities†twilio.org】 by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
L64: So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, 【5†please consider other open positions.†www.twilio.com】

L11: The Junior ML Engineer will support the Company's data science function by developing, validating, and maintaining machine learning models and the data pipelines behind them. L12: We're a Data Team that operates like a scaleup within an established company: real ownership, short decision paths, and room to shape things. L13: It is an environment with a high level of trust, autonomy, and strong opportunities to learn from experienced peers across both technical and business topics.

L11: Incubator for AI, i.AI
L12: 
L13: Help shape how people interact with some of the most ambitious AI products in government
L14: The Incubator for AI (i.AI) is a team of ~80 builders and operators using frontier AI to improve public services across healthcare, education, planning and parliament. We combine startup pace and autonomy with the opportunity to tackle national-scale challenges.
L15: 
L16: We operate under three core principles:
L17: 
L18: Talent: We bring together the UK’s best AI talent across a range of functions. You will work alongside exceptional researchers and top government leaders, staying at the cutting edge of technology.
L19: Innovation: We set precedents for what is possible in government. We combine the pace of a start-up with the influence of being at the digital centre of government. You will test new ideas, expand what is possible, and leverage unique government data to create novel solutions.
L20: Impact: We are dedicated to using AI as a tool for public good - this can mean improving outcomes in schools, boosting housebuilding or providing more personalised support for those in need. With the backing of the Prime Minister, you will turn technical breakthroughs into real-world applications that affect millions of citizens.
L21: 
L22: About the role
L23: i.AI’s Impact and Evaluation team build their work into each stage of product development, from scoping, to incubation, and onwards to scaling. Team members embed into product development teams, designing and delivering robust evaluations at each stage of the product journey to inform their design and, ultimately, understand their impact on the quality and efficiency of public service delivery.
L24: The team is now recruiting for two Senior AI Evaluation Engineers, to lead the evaluation of AI products. These roles will focus on model-level evaluation, including assessment of accuracy, bias and safety.
L25: 
L26: What you will work on
L27:   * Lead the design and development of evaluation pipelines and experiments across AI products
L28:   * Architect product-wide evaluation suites that integrate with engineering and CI/CD workflows
L29:   * Design and implement complex and exploratory evaluation methods to assess accuracy, bias, safety and overall model performance
L30:   * Work closely with product, engineering and domain experts to shape evaluation approaches throughout the product lifecycle
L31:   * Design and run evaluation experiments that directly inform product development and technical decisions
L32:   * Analyse complex evaluation results and turn findings into clear recommendations for technical, product and senior stakeholders
L33:   * Lead the communication of evaluation findings through reports, presentations and external publications
L34:   * Support and review evaluation work from other engineers, helping to raise standards and develop evaluation capability across the team
L35: Who we think will thrive in this role
L36: 
L37: You may be a strong fit if you bring some of the following:
L38:   * Broad experience of evaluating generative and predictive AI systems
L39:   * Extensive knowledge of experimental design and statistical hypothesis testing
L40:   * Highly proficient in Python
L41:   * Demonstrable experience of software development tools and practices (e.g. git, CI/CD, unit testing)
L42:   * Ability to communicate technical work to a broad audience, using different media/formats e.g. technical reports, presentations, and web-based tools.
L43:   * Experience implementing LLM-as-a-judge and other generative AI evaluation techniques using AI evaluation tools (e.g. pydantic evals, deepeval, inspect)
L44:   * Experience using pipeline orchestration tools e.g. DVC, snakemake
L45:   * Knowledge of standard quantitative research designs, methods and analysis (particularly those set out in the Magenta Book)
L46:   * Experience of mentoring junior colleagues
L47: What we offer
L48: 
L49: Career-defining projects with outsized impact
L50: 
L51:   * Backing from the Prime Minister and No10 to scope and build transformative AI projects.
L52:   * Unique opportunities to apply technology that could transform the public sector and impact citizens’ lives.
L53:   * Talented, supportive and mission-driven colleagues.
L54: 
L55: Resources & access
L56:   * Access to frontier models and ample compute.
L57:   * Extensive operational, product, strategy, design and delivery support so you can focus on shipping.
L58:   * Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences.
L59: 
L60: Growth & empowerment
L61:   * A team culture and development support that prioritises personal growth.
L62:   * Opportunities to own important products early and develop them in small empowered teams.
L63:   * 5 days off learning and development, annual stipends for learning and development and funding for conferences and external collaborations.
L64: 
L65: Life & family*
L66:   * Opportunity to work from London, Manchester or Bristol offices.
L67:   * Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment.
L68:   * Generous annual leave - 25 days plus one additional day for each year of service
L69:   * Generous paid parental leave (up to 39 weeks full pay + option for additional unpaid time).
L70:   * On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension.
L71:   * Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, dental insurance, donations and retail/gyms.
L72: *These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for people joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments.

L8: The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d) VLA Training & Evaluation, who will build the frameworks for fine-tuning and benchmarking robot foundation models on collected robot data. The frameworks are meant to work across different foundation models and for teams with modest data and compute.
L9: ### Responsibilities
L10:   * Training Workflows: Build reusable, model-agnostic training and evaluation workflows, with experiment tracking, model versioning, and checkpoint management, so that different foundation models can be swapped in without rebuilding the pipeline.
L11:   * Fine-Tuning: Implement fine-tuning of pretrained vision-language-action models on collected robot data, for example with parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA or adapters, or with distillation.
L12:   * Policy Training: Build training loops for action-chunking and transformer-based action models, diffusion policies, and VLM/VLA heads.
L13:   * Benchmarks: Build benchmarks with generalization splits, success metrics, and failure-analysis templates.
L14:   * Transfer Studies: Work with simulation engineers on studies, including metrics and ablations, that test whether improvements in simulation realism improve performance on the real robot.
L15:   * Research Baselines: Turn published methods into working baselines and templates that others can extend.
L16: ### Essential Skills
L17:   * Academic Background: Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field (Master’s or PhD typical), or an equivalent combination of formal training and demonstrated experience training deep learning models.
L18:   * Training Internals: Hands-on experience writing and debugging training loops in PyTorch or JAX, including data loading, loss design, and optimizer behavior.
L19:   * Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning pretrained models and adapting them to new tasks and data.
L20:   * Robot Learning: Working understanding of how imitation-learned policies, such as action-chunking or diffusion policies, turn observations into robot actions.
L21:   * Experiment Management: Experience designing evaluations and ablations, and running experiments with tracking, versioning, and checkpoint management so that others can reproduce them.
L22: ### Beneficial Skills
L23: 
L24:   * VLA Models: Experience fine-tuning vision-language-action or vision-language models for robot control.
L25:   * Real-Robot Evaluation: Experience evaluating learned policies on physical robots.
L26:   * Sim-to-Real: Familiarity with measuring how well models trained in simulation transfer to real hardware.

L53: ## How we're different
L54: We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science.
L55: We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
L56: The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

L11: 
L12: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact.
L13: Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains.
L14: Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable: end to end.
L15: 
L16: ABOUT THE ROLE:
L17: Portcast has already been used by global freight forwarding companies, manufacturers and cargo airlines. Our customers trust us to deliver fast, reliable and secure predictions, our engine answers when, where, why, and by how many days a container will be delayed. That trust lives or dies on data quality, and that's what you'll own.
L18: As our Data Analyst, you will be reporting directly to our Analytics Manager and work closely with our Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams. You'll sit on a data-heavy product that gives customers end-to-end visibility of their cargo across the ocean journey, making sure the data we ingest into the models and share with customers is error-free and of the highest quality. You won't just run the query and close the ticket here.
L19: When an anomaly shows up, you'll chase why it's there, trace it to the real source, and fix the process so it doesn't come back. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build.
L20: ### WHAT YOU'LL OWN:
L21: 
L22:   * Documentation, reporting, and root-cause analysis of prediction issues: owning the problem end to end, not just flagging it.
L23: 
L24:   * Analyze ingested and system-generated data for anomalies and gaps, and refer to various data sources to plug those gaps.
L25: 
L26:   * Turn data into stories: surface the pattern behind an issue, propose the fix (QA process-flow change and/or automation), and own the subsequent plan and execution.
L27:   * Automate performance/accuracy review processes, report generation, and data visualization using Python and SQL: building reusable, scalable workflows, not one-off scripts.
L28: 
L29:   * Support Engineering and Data Science on system-level data fixes. Understand how the engine makes predictions, and explore improvements by fixing or introducing new data and features.
L30:   * Support Customer Operations and Marketing with insights from the data: performance, accuracy metrics, the impact of real-time events, as needed.
L31: 
L32:   * Maintain and own internal and customer dashboards based on trial/account requirements (prediction accuracy, timeliness, coverage, explainability).
L33: ### WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
L34: 
L35:   * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
L36: 
L37:   * At least 2-3+ years in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role, preferably in a product-based, lean startup particularly in logistics, ecommerce or B2B SaaS data-heavy domain.
L38: 
L39:   * Exceptionally skilled in Python and SQL, with a demonstrated ability to consistently produce reusable and highly scalable code.
L40:   * An eye for detail: you go looking for anomalies in the system before a customer does, and proven experience turning messy data into clear visualizations.
L41: 
L42:   * First Principles Thinker: when you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new tool when a tighter use of an existing one would do the job.
L43:   * Curious by Default: you dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When the data surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix, and you ask the good questions early.
L44:   * You own your output, AI included. You use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, etc.) where they make you faster on QA, automation, and analysis, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read and validate what they produce — you don't just paste it. You can explain the anomaly, the root cause, and the fix without saying "the AI found it," and you flag AI-assisted work without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking.
L45:   * Empathy and Urgency: you feel the customer's pain and react promptly on a day-to-day basis (either programmatically or manually) to meet expectations and deliver on time.
L46: 
L47:   * You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a data decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed.
L48:   * You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic, and cross-cultural team, with a strong ownership mindset, efficiency, and a data-driven approach.
L49: 
L50:   * Good to have: a basic understanding of machine learning algorithms.
L51: ### WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:
L52: 
L53:   * Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious.
L54: 
L55:   * Data-first team: You'll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems with data.
L56:   * Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning data quality and analytics from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains, and you'll be a major part of our story.
L57: 
L58:   * Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You'll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward.
L59: ### Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:
L60: 
L61:   * Curiosity: We read the data before we trust it. We dig into why a number looks the way it does, not just how to make the anomaly disappear.
L62: 
L63:   * Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for someone to flag a data issue, and we stay on a problem until it's actually fixed at the source.
L64:   * Raising the bar: We don't settle for a report that only works this once. We aim for data pipelines and dashboards that are reliable, reusable, and easy for the team to trust.
L65: 
L66:   * Effectiveness: We focus on analysis that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship work that improves outcomes, not just output.
L67: Join us at Portcast and be part of a high-performing team that is shaping the future of the logistics and shipping industry through cutting-edge predictive analytics!

L12: As a Junior Data Scientist at Samba in Amsterdam, you will own end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects with minimal guidance. L26:   * Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations — translate business requirements into technical specifications, partner with data engineering on scalable pipeline design, and participate in cross-functional design reviews and working groups

L29: 
L30:

L32:

L10: Сейчас в SMT есть ручные проверки и автоматические API-тесты, но нет единой сквозной системы. Ищем Data Quality Engineer, который станет техническим владельцем направления в SMT: построит модель, инструменты и процессы, а затем поможет масштабировать их на всю платформу.

Твоя задача дать им автоматические базовые проверки и понятный self-service инструмент для сложных правил, встроенный в оркестрацию, алертинг и разбор инцидентов.

L15:   * Сделать базовые проверки автоматическими: генерировать их из метаданных при создании и обновлении датасетов.
L16:   * Дать пользователям язык для сложных проверок декларативный конфиг, SQL-правила или собственный подход. Выбор за тобой.
L17:   * Реализовать quality gates: карантин, блокировку публикации, остановку пайплайна, fallback или откат там, где это возможно.
L18:   * Настроить наблюдаемость: адресный алертинг, дашборды состояния датасетов, health-score, контроль ложных срабатываний и разбор причин.

L20:   * Сделать проверки частью инженерного цикла: версионировать их как код, проводить ревью и доставлять через CI/CD.
L21:   * Поддержать миграцию существующих процессов на платформу: построить сверку старого и нового контуров и доказательно подтверждать совпадение цифр.
L22:   * Совместно с Data Governance и владельцами данных задавать стандарты покрытия и ревью. Помогать инженерам применять инструменты, а не писать все проверки за них.
L23:   * Работать с аналитиками как с пользователями: разбираться, где им больно, и делать инструмент, которым пользуются добровольно.

L12: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Finance Data Analyst based in Poland.
L13: As a Finance Data Analyst, you will transform complex financial and operational data into reliable insights that support strategic decision-making and business performance. You will bridge the gap between Finance and technical teams, ensuring data is consistent, accessible, and actionable. Working across finance, revenue, operations, HR, and cloud infrastructure systems, you will help structure datasets, improve reporting, and automate recurring analyses.
L14: You will play a key role in strengthening data quality, standardizing financial metrics, and improving forecasting and performance monitoring. In a fast-evolving, technology-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable reporting processes and support future analytical initiatives. This is an opportunity to combine financial expertise, technical skills, and business curiosity to deliver measurable impact.
L15: ### Accountabilities:
L16:   * Map and document financial and corporate data sources, systems, ownership, definitions, and data flows to improve transparency and consistency.
L17:   * Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and reconciliation issues across accounting, billing, CRM, HR, payroll, cash management, and expense-management systems.
L18:   * Define data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, ensuring key financial and operational metrics are clearly defined and consistently calculated.
L19:   * Explore, transform, and model data from data warehouses and connected business systems to create reliable, reusable, and well-documented datasets.
L20:   * Reconcile data across multiple sources and investigate discrepancies to improve the accuracy and reliability of financial and corporate reporting.
L21:   * Produce recurring financial analyses, dashboards, and reporting to support leadership decisions, including budget-versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS performance analysis.
L22:   * Collaborate with data engineering teams and system owners to improve integrations, transformations, data accessibility, and quality checks.
L23:   * Automate recurring reporting, reconciliations, and analytical workflows where automation can deliver meaningful efficiency gains.
L24:   * Maintain documentation covering data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations.
L25:   * Contribute to data governance and quality monitoring, preparing reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI-driven use cases.
L26:   * Handle confidential financial, HR, and payroll information with discretion, accuracy, and a strong commitment to data protection.
L27: ## Requirements:
L28:   * At least 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, financial analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related analytical role.
L29:   * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data across multiple systems and identify the root causes of discrepancies.
L30:   * Good command of SQL and practical experience with at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool.
L31:   * Ability to translate business questions into clear data requirements, meaningful metrics, and actionable analyses.
L32:   * Solid understanding of financial concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash flow, costs, and unit economics.
L33:   * Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to review, audit, and structure existing financial models.
L34:   * Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both Finance and technical stakeholders.
L35:   * Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.
L36:   * A rigorous, curious, and structured approach to data quality, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and make definitions explicit.
L37:   * Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and deliver practical solutions in a changing business environment.
L38: Nice-to-have qualifications:
L39:   * Experience in a B2B SaaS, software, technology, or scale-up environment.
L40:   * Familiarity with SaaS revenue metrics, including MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.
L41:   * Understanding of SaaS cost structures, including cloud storage, compute, data retention, AI-related expenses, and gross margin.
L42:   * Experience with finance, accounting, billing, CRM, HRIS, payroll, expense-management, or financial planning tools.
L43:   * Knowledge of data warehouses, data modeling, ETL processes, APIs, or data quality frameworks.
L44:   * Experience with Python or another programming language for analysis and automation.
L45:   * Previous exposure to sensitive HR or payroll data and an understanding of the confidentiality requirements involved.
L46: Candidates who meet most, but not necessarily all, of these requirements are encouraged to apply. A strong willingness to learn, analytical thinking, and the ability to demonstrate relevant skills are equally valued.
L47: ## Benefits:
L48:   * Full-time employment in a role with meaningful exposure to financial strategy and business performance.
L49:   * Opportunity to work in a technology-driven environment alongside Finance, Data Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
L50:   * Scope to improve reporting processes, strengthen data quality, and contribute to automation and advanced analytics initiatives.
L51:   * Opportunities to develop expertise in financial analytics, business intelligence, data modeling, and SaaS performance metrics.
L52:   * A collaborative working environment that values clear communication, continuous improvement, and practical problem-solving.
L53:   * Potential exposure to future forecasting, anomaly detection, and AI-driven analytical projects.
L54:   * Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, flexibility, and other employment benefits to be confirmed with the hiring company.
